description: Show what changed on a map compared with an earlier version: a text summary (changed tile cells, added/removed/moved/edited events) plus a PNG of the CURRENT map with changed cells outlined yellow and added or moved events outlined green. By default it compares with the most recent backup session that contains the map (the state before this session's first edit); pass against.session to pick a session folder from list_backups, or against.changeset to compare with the pre-image of a committed changeset. Use it after bulk painting or generation to review exactly what you touched. If the map has no earlier version this session, it says so.

against.description: Which earlier version to compare with (default: the most recent backup session containing this map)

changeset.description: Changeset id; compares with its pre-edit copy of the map

tileSize.description: Pixels per map tile; reduced automatically so the image stays under ~1600px

name: render_diff
title: Render map changes
